L36.label: afflicted
L36.quote: The rative, a duke of the British royalty married a common woman who was a divorcee. The proposed marriage created a furore in the country but the native married the woman of his choice for whom he had to abdicate the throne.
L36.note: Example of an unconventional marriage; Raman stresses the scandal, the abdication and the afflicted 8th (marital bond), not marital unhappiness as such.

L37.label: favourable
L37.quote: Lagna lord, subject to neechabhanga in the 10th by Venus, who in his turn has caused Malavya Yoga, clearly reveals that Einstein was undoubtedly one of the greatest mankind has ever produced.
L37.note: The career events (Prague professorship, Kaiser Wilhelm Institute directorship, Nobel Prize) are also described as fruits of the dasas.

L38.label: afflicted
L38.quote: The fourth house is not much afflicted, but the lord and Karaka are moderately blemished. The native lost his mother in Saturn Dasha Venus Bhukti.
L38.note: The packet window showed Charts 88-92; Chart 73 is at line 4646. The mother's death is given with no age, so how early it came is not stated.

L39.label: favourable
L39.quote: Jaimini's dictum that Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa gives one Kaivalya or final emancipation is literally applicable in this case.
L39.note: Found in the Remarks, beyond the packet window.

L40.label: favourable
L40.quote: The native will earn well in Jupiter Dasha as he aspects the special Dhana Lagna. Since Saturn is a pure malefic, he will give better financial prospects in the course of his Dasha.
L40.note: Dhana Lagna judgment stated as a forecast, not an outcome; Raman adds that Jupiter's power to do good is somewhat restricted.

L41.label: favourable
L41.quote: The horoscope has three important Raja Yogas, justifying the exalted position of the native.
L41.note: The packet window ended at the chart header; the conclusion was found further on (he inherited the empire and his reign was 'colourful and unique').

L42.label: afflicted
L42.quote: Though Jupiter is well-disposed in the horoscope, the Karaka and the third house are subject to affliction. The native has no brothers.

L43.label: none
L43.note: Raman reads exalted Venus in the 2nd only as the absence of passions; he says nothing about wealth for Ramakrishna.

L44.label: afflicted
L44.quote: The fourth house is moderately strong. But the lord cum Karaka is considerably afflicted The mother died at the age of 9 in Rahu Dasha Rahu Bhukti.
L44.note: The packet window was the wrong passage; Chart 69 is at line 4562.

L45.label: afflicted
L45.quote: The native had an attack of IB. in Moon Dasha, Venus Bhukti, Sun Antara.
L45.note: T.B. attack; he was also jailed five times (6th/11th lord combination).

L46.label: favourable
L46.quote: The chart is strongly placed for financial gains. The 11th house being aspected by Mercury and Rahu and Saturn has given the native engineering (Mercury and Rahu) industries (Saturn) worth several crores.

L47.label: favourable
L47.quote: The native had 8 issues out of which one died.
L47.note: Raman judges the 5th house fairly well disposed and predicted about 9 children.

L48.label: afflicted
L48.quote: The heavy aspect, involving the 7th and 8th houses, emphasises the unhappiness in Farouk's demostic life
L48.note: The first marriage was later dissolved (Venus Bhukti) and he remarried.

L49.label: favourable
L49.quote: The house of children is fairly well disposed, the 5th lord being in the 7th and forming a yoga with Putrakaraka, suggesting happiness through children and corning to prominence of the eldest issue.
L49.note: The native was supported by his son.

L50.label: afflicted
L50.quote: In Venus Dasha, Rahu Bhukti the native had a serious attack of typhoid. (Chart No. 115)
L50.note: He also had bronchitis in Saturn Bhukti.

L51.label: afflicted
L51.quote: Conclusion: The native has no surviving elder brother.
L51.note: One elder brother was born but died in Venus Dasa Saturn Bhukti.

L52.label: afflicted
L52.quote: The native is suffering from myopia.
L52.note: The disease is myopia (6th lord in the 2nd, 2nd lord with the 8th lord in the 12th).

L53.label: favourable
L53.quote: The strong disposition of the house, the lord and the Karaka or indicator conferred on the native high education

L54.label: none
L54.note: Raman reads the 4th lord and 4th house for legal brilliance and giving up legal practice; the mother appears only as passing on an inheritance. No conclusion about the mother.

L55.label: favourable
L55.quote: As Jupiter is in Karmasthana, Vivekananda became a great exponent of Advaita Vedanta

L56.label: favourable
L56.quote: It must be noted that he was considered to be the greatest Tamil poet of his times.
L56.note: Raman also says Mars with Ketu is not desirable for political success, but his overall verdict on the work is a great poet and author.

L57.label: favourable
L57.quote: These and the concentration of 5 planets on the 10th house made the native a ruler (prime minister).
L57.note: Nehru. One minor caveat: as an administrator he could not make the impression he made as a thinker.

L58.label: afflicted
L58.quote: The native of Chart No. 254 suffers from weak eye-sight, in addition, he sees a blinking aura before his eyes.

L59.label: afflicted
L59.quote: This not only indicates complete absence of marital happiness but his extra marital sex excursions.
L59.note: He also had an early divorce and his second wife died.

L60.label: favourable
L60.quote: This combination enabled Roosevelt to reach the highest position in life that is possible in a democratic country and to live the hard and exacting life of a great statesman.

L61.label: afflicted
L61.quote: But the 5th house indications are a source of misery for the native. One male issue was horn in 1922 and died immediately. Subsequently there were two abortions.

L62.label: favourable
L62.quote: the 5th house is well disposed. The 5th lord Venus and Putrakaraka Jupiter have gained 7 and 8 Navamsas respectively. Consequently, the number of surviving children are 7.
L62.note: She later lost her eldest son, but Raman's verdict on the 5th house is favourable.

L63.label: afflicted
L63.quote: This is an unfavourable combination which always retards success in life. Saturn's sub-period in Mars Dasa was a bit favourable from the financial point of view. The horoscope is that of an ordinary man, drawing about Rs. 50 to 60 a month.
L63.note: Modest means, not destitution; all three wealth factors are judged bad.

L64.label: mixed
L64.quote: Arishta yogas for suffer- ing evenly balanced with Rajayogas and Lagna and Lagna lord fully fortified reveal Tilak's stainless purity of life, immense sacrifice
L64.note: Raman also says the actual enjoyment of the Rajayoga is denied ('he might have wielded power as a great statesman'), yet he was left 'uncrowned king of India'.

L65.label: afflicted
L65.quote: Consequently the person lost his mother in his 16th year in Moon Dasha Saturn Bhukti.
L65.note: Chart 68 starts at line 4543 (the packet window was wrong). The conclusion sentence is displaced by a page break to just after the Chart 69 header. The Moon Dasa timing fits Chart 68 (1896), not Chart 69. At line 4560 Raman also writes 'The fourth house is considerably afflicted'.

L66.label: none
L66.note: Vivekananda was a sannyasi and never married. Raman reads the unafflicted 7th and pure Venus only as celibacy ('must doubtless have been a true Brahmachari'); he gives no verdict on a spouse or marriage.

L67.label: favourable
L67.quote: The native's father must therefore live fairly long.
L67.note: Raman adds that this native's father is 'a man of international renown and the leading authority in his field well established in life' (line 8442).

L68.label: afflicted
L68.quote: As a result of these combinations, Lincoln was assassinated.
L68.note: Violent death by weapon (Mrityu Yoga from Saturn in the 10th).

L69.label: mixed
L69.quote: Evidently Shivaji was unlettered. But since Gnanakaraka Jupiter is strongly placed aspecting as he does the lord of the 4th, want of book-learning was more than compensated by his mastery of the great Hindu epics
L69.note: Raman says plainly he had no formal education, but also gives a strong compensating verdict on his learning.

L70.label: favourable
L70.quote: His earning capacity was indeed very good because Saturn lord of the 2nd is exalted in the 10th and joins Venus thus forming a Rajayoga.
L70.note: The Remarks on vocation also stress his prolific output and renown.
